item.title: NCT Dream to release sixth studio album next month
item.description:
Korea Herald • Comeback / release
NCT Dream announced Friday that it will release its sixth studio album, “Dream After Dream,” on Nov. 9, according to label SM Entertainment. This is the group's first release since it reorganized into a six-member act in April, when Mark left both the team and the label to pursue a solo career.
